Name: Ordinary Elliott and Yandere Elliott Portraits for Portraiture
Author: Gabihime
Description:
Do you wish your bleak, depressed writer who lives alone on the beach looked a little more bleak?  Well now he can be as bleak as you like, with two different options: decaf bleak and EXTRA bleak.  (Elliott is just an extra kind of guy).

Full portrait set for normal Elliot, including beach portraits, as well as for yandere Elliott, also including beach portraits.  Additional expressions have been added to both sets to fill them out and there are no duplicates between them.

And just like any ordinary self-respecting author, Elliott is rarely without his [url=https://www.montblanc.com/en-us/fountain-pens_cod22527730565448102.html]offensively expensive fountain pen[/url]﻿.  If you’re lucky, you might also get to see his favorite letter opener!

You need portraiture installed for these.  

Just drop the set of your choice into the subfolder of portraits you’re using inside of the “portraits” folder of the portraiture mod.  That’s a lot of portraits!

Although you’re free to use these portraits as you like, with whatever mods you like, I would of course suggest the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8807]Yandere Elliott [/url]﻿mod for use with the yandere Elliott portraits.

Like with my other portraits, these are meant to be friends with the portraits by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15234]LT4823[/url]﻿ because these are the portraits that I use.
